ios.desc:
Film & Edit Vlogs in one app. A Digital Vlog Camera, Video Editor, AI Video & Pro Thumbnail maker.

Reelshot is the #1 Vlog Camera and Video editor built for effortless vlogging. Make 4K Youtube Vlogs or TikTok, Reels & Shorts.

Loved by 100,000+ creators worldwide. Featured by Apple.

Start recording. Clips automatically add to projects.

Make Quick Recaps, Montages, Vlog Intro's and Previews.

Trim 100's of clips to the same length in a tap. Make Recaps for life in seconds.

Browse your history of content from specific dates and add photos and videos from your library.

Private, intuitive, and perfect for YouTube, TikTok, Reels & Shorts.

VIDEO CAMERA & VLOGGING HIGHLIGHTS

- 4K Video Camera with unlimited filming
- Cinematic & Hyper Stabilization
- Discreet Mode: Hold portrait, shoot landscape
- Set timer and shot lengths: Hold record to override for talking shots. No need to fiddle around with settings.
- Real-Time Editing: Switch between A/B Roll while recording to save time editing.
- Home & Lock Screen widgets: Never miss a shot.
- Set FPS: 24 / 30 / 60 / 120 / 240
- Save camera settings per project
- Export in 4K with full control
- Align shots with Ghost Layer
- No Recording limits: Reelshot is made for short, medium and long form content.
- Flash, countdown timer, lens switch
- Pause/Resume multi-shot recording
- Wireless remote friendly

The perfect digital camera app / camcorder to become an effortless vlogger.

CREATION INSPIRATION & TEMPLATES

Select your perfect project to start vlogging.

- Day in the life
- Mini vlog
- Behind the scenes
- Week in the life
- Private journal
- Video Diary
- Uni vlog
- Couples vlog
- Errands vlog
- My First vlog
- Summer vlog
- 48 Hours in...
- Travel Vlog
- Work Project
- Silent Vlog
- Food Diary
- 30 Day Challenge
- Selfie Diary
- 2026 Journal

& many more

ESSENTIAL EDITING FEATURES

- Trim, split, crop, duplicate, rotate, mirror
- Add Text: Fonts, Colour, align, add timestamp of video
- Timestamps: One tap add timestamps (time / date) to all videos.
- Add premium beats or your own music
- Use AI to generate music
- Combine & sort videos
- Speed editor & real-time touch speed controls
- One-tap Recaps: Make all shots the same length
- Canvas selection & social media formats
- Align next shot with previous in canvas
- Reverse video, transitions, volume control
- Delete excess footage & save device storage
- Undo friendly

EASY PROJECT MANAGEMENT

- Keep unlimited projects — journals, recaps & vlogs
- Recap
